item_name: Rothco Enhanced G.I. Type Rip-Stop Poncho Liner With Zipper
item_short_desc: Rothco's Rip-Stop Poncho Liner, also known as the Woobie, offers versatile functionality and added warmth in extreme conditions. The military poncho liner can be used as a lightweight blanket, make-shift tent, sleeping bag, or liner for a variety of outdoor activities, such as camping, hiking, backpacking, fishing, hunting, and more. The Woobie measures 62 inch x 82 inch, providing ample coverage against harsh weather conditions while keeping you warm and dry.
